info.name: TCOS - Pages
info.description: TCOS portfolio API (public, read-only). Import TCOS-Local.postman_environment.json first. List requests save a real slug/key for the detail requests; with an empty database those are skipped. Never save a real admin token in these files.

exec: // 404 until a Home page is in the database.
pm.test("status 200, or 404 while there is no Home page", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 404]));
pm.test("blocks have id, type, title", () => h.blocks.forEach((b) => pm.expect(b).to.include.keys("id", "type", "title")));
